               *   @brief This file implements the AUTOSAR EthSM module.The EthSM module is responsible for providing abstract 
               *   interface to the AUTOSAR Communication Manager to startup or shutdown the communication on an Ethernet cluster
               *   by accessing Ethernet Interface layer to control the Ethernet HW i,e Controllers, Transceivers and switches.

               /*! @brief Defines the EthSM Network status type */

               {

                   {
11 2    (T)        case ETHSM_STATE_OFFLINE:
11 3     *           EthSM_UpdateControllerMode(NetworkHandle);

11 4.1  (T)(F)       1 == EthSM_CheckTrcvMode(NetworkHandle, ETHTRCV_MODE_ACTIVE)) &&
                              (

                           {

11 10.1 (T)(F)         EthSM_NetworkStatus[NetworkHandle].TcpIpState == TCPIP_STATE_ONLINE)
                               {
11 11    *               EthSM_ChangeNetworkModeState(NetworkHandle,ETHSM_STATE_WAIT_ONLINE);
                               }
                               else
                               {

                               }
                           }
11 13    *           break;
11 14   (T)        case ETHSM_STATE_WAIT_ONLINE:
11 15    *           EthSM_FullComWaitOnlineStateHandler(NetworkHandle);
11 16    *           break;
11 17   (T)        case ETHSM_STATE_ONLINE:

11 19    *           break;

                   }

               *   @brief      This service process for EthSM No Com state

12 1     *       Channel = (pEthSMConfig->pNetworkConfig[NetworkHandle].EthSMComMNetworkHandle);

12 3    (T)        case ETHSM_STATE_WAIT_TRCVLINK:

12 11    *           break;
12 12   (T)        case ETHSM_STATE_ONLINE:

                           else

12 15    *             EthSM_RequestTcpIpModeChg(NetworkHandle,TCPIP_STATE_OFFLINE);

12 16    *           break;

12 19   (T)(F)       if(
12 19.1 (T)(F)       EthSM_NetworkStatus[NetworkHandle].NetworkMode == ETHSM_STATE_ONHOLD)

12 23    *           EthSM_UpdateControllerMode(NetworkHandle);
12 24   (T)(F)       if(

12 25.1 (T)(F)         EthSM_NetworkStatus[NetworkHandle].CtrlMode == (0x00u)) &&
